title: Database import refuses malformed and stalled pages, preserves view order, retries storage and fences redirects
steps: Run the named HTTP fault cases against the branch exporter.
expect: Malformed and stalled replies never reach storage.
View DDL follows base tables in dependency order.
A transient upload recovers and cross-origin redirects receive no token.
Large binary payloads and WordPress login diagnosis are handled.

cmd: --test-name-pattern=database export refuses|legacy cursors and offsets|view definitions follow|transient database storage|cross-origin 307|large binary literal|WordPress login form
tests: database export refuses malformed replies before signing a storage upload
legacy cursors and offsets stop on a repeated page or zero progress
view definitions follow all base tables in dependency order from the engine
a transient database storage refusal or reset retries the complete compressed upload
cross-origin 307 never forwards an engine token
a database page with a large binary literal does not overflow base64 validation
a WordPress login form after a valid engine reply retains the login diagnosis
